applies_to: every filing in manifest.json (latest 10-K per filer)

questions.question: What was total net revenue (net sales) for the latest fiscal year?
What was net income for the latest fiscal year (attributable to the company's shareholders where the statement separates it)?
What was diluted earnings per share for the latest fiscal year?
What were total assets at fiscal year end?
What were cash and cash equivalents at fiscal year end?
How many employees does the company report?
What is the fiscal year end date of the report?
Who is the independent registered public accounting firm (auditor)?
What is the company's state of incorporation?
What was long-term debt (non-current, excluding current maturities) at fiscal year end?
